connectionStepLoad.message: Click {load}, select the extension folder below, and keep the extension enabled:

connectionStepReturn.message: After signing in, return to this {page}. Open {extension} from the Extensions menu at the top.

connectionStepApprove.message: Select {consent}, then click {connect} to connect the session.

extensionDescription.message: Connect an explicitly approved ChatGPT login session to OpenCode on this computer.

instructions.message: Log in to ChatGPT in this Chrome profile, then return to the OpenCode-ChatGPT connection tab and open this extension.

consent.message: I authorize importing this ChatGPT session into OpenCode on this computer.

privacy.message: No Google cookies, passwords, chat history, or API credentials are transferred. The extension never saves your session to a file.

statusImported.message: Imported. Return to OpenCode GPT-Pro config page to verify.

errorTab.message: Open a new OpenCode-ChatGPT connection page on 127.0.0.1, then open this extension from that tab.

errorProfile.message: Cannot identify this Chrome profile. Keep the OpenCode-ChatGPT connection tab active.

errorNoSession.message: No supported ChatGPT session found. Log in to ChatGPT in this Chrome profile, then try again.

errorConnection.message: Connection failed. Open a new connection from OpenCode.

errorImport.message: Import not confirmed. Check the GPT-Pro config page in OpenCode.

errorInvalidSession.message: The ChatGPT session is invalid or unsupported. Log in again in Chrome, then open a new connection from OpenCode.

errorUnauthorized.message: Connection authorization failed. Open a new connection from OpenCode.

errorInUse.message: This connection is already in use. Check OpenCode; do not repeatedly resend.

errorExpired.message: The connection has expired. Open a new connection from OpenCode.
